name: meridian-assistant-extension
description: Meridian Assistant: Chrome and Safari Web Extension for assisted job-application forms

scripts.build:e2e: node build.mjs --variant=e2e && node build.mjs --variant=e2e-closed && node build.mjs --variant=e2e-top
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:e2e
scripts.zip: npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/zip.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check && npm test
